##### Project general facts

Monaco Mansions by Azizi Developments is a collection of ultra-luxury waterfront villas within a large lagoon master community, arranged in eight clusters surrounded by Venetian-style lagoons, green parks and striking architecture. Designs range from royal classicism to contemporary minimalism, with facades oriented towards both the road and the water. The collection offers exclusive six- to eight-bedroom mansions, each spread over four levels connected by a private lift.

Every mansion features two private swimming pools, one at ground level and one on the roof, with a terrace for relaxation and an alfresco dining area. Inside, residents enjoy a home cinema, a study, a fitness centre and a private spa with a hammam, a sauna, a jacuzzi, massage rooms and an ice shower, while the wider community adds a cultural district, restaurants, a hospital, schools, a mosque, sports courts and a private beach.

Interiors are designed with sculptural staircases, crystal chandeliers, panoramic windows and generous living and bar areas that create a refined, palatial atmosphere. Every detail reflects exceptional craftsmanship and attention to privacy and comfort. Furnishing is optional, with buyers able to choose a complete designer furniture package or to furnish the residence to their own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South is a large master-planned city district in the south of Dubai, built around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. Residential neighbourhoods, logistics and business parks, schools, clinics and community retail are planned side by side, while a lagoon community with a boulevard, parks and cultural venues brings a resort-style lifestyle to the district.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Sheikh Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city. Al Maktoum International Airport is a short drive away, Expo City Dubai and Dubai Parks and Resorts are close by, and Palm Jebel Ali, the Jebel Ali Free Zone and Dubai Marina are within comfortable driving distance for work, leisure and travel.

Dubai South offers freehold ownership to international buyers and is one of the fastest-growing districts in Dubai. Expansion of Al Maktoum International Airport and the continued growth of Expo City Dubai support strong long-term demand. Ultra-luxury waterfront mansions with private pools and spas are in very limited supply, attracting high-net-worth families and investors seeking exclusivity and long-term capital growth.
